function.name: inspect_video
function.description: Inspect one generated video and its audio. Return eight categorical dimension ratings (good, fair, bad or n/a) and grounded findings with repair goals. Scoring, acceptance and regeneration decisions are downstream responsibilities.

video_path.description: Local path to the actual generated video, including its audio. Supply the intended 768p artifact; this tool does not select or resize videos.

original_request.description: The original user video request, preserved unchanged.

generation_prompt.description: The exact rewritten prompt actually used to generate this video.
